protocols.name: Uniswap
protocols.notes: Universal Router: the Uniswap interface (Uniswap/interface @1f602ef, TradingApiClient.ts) requests UR 2.0 by default and 2.1.1 behind a feature flag, and 2.2.0 only for permissioned-pool tokens; the Trading API defaults integrators to 2.1.2 (newer deployments 2.1.2/2.2.0 and the older UR 1.2 are omitted). v2 Router02 on OP Mainnet omitted (deployed but little used). Permit2 is covered by another group.

protocols.name: Aero (Aerodrome + Velodrome)
protocols.notes: On 2026-10-22 Aerodrome (Base) and Velodrome (OP) upgraded together into Aero (Dromos Labs MetaDEX) on Ethereum, Base, OP Mainnet and Arbitrum (also Ink, Arc, Robinhood). Legacy gauges were switched off and emissions stopped; legacy pools stay live and users exit through the legacy contracts (see aerodrome, velodrome). Addresses cross-checked against app.aero.xyz/docs/security.
